prose:
A session controller has states INIT, READY, ACTIVE, PAUSED, FAULT, DONE and three registers: boolean A, boolean T, integer n. Initial state: INIT, A=false, T=false, n=0.

An event fires only if the current state is in its allowed list AND its guard holds (guards are evaluated against register values just before the event). A fired event applies its effects in order. Any other event is REJECTED: nothing changes and the event is counted.

Transition rules:
  HELLO: allowed in INIT, ACTIVE, FAULT, DONE; requires n >= 1. Effects: A=false, n + 2, go DONE.
  AUTH: allowed in INIT, READY; requires A. Effects: n + 1, go FAULT.
  OPEN: allowed in INIT, PAUSED, FAULT. Effects: T=true, go FAULT.
  PAUSE: allowed in READY, PAUSED, FAULT. Effects: T=false, n + 2, go FAULT.
  RESUME: allowed in PAUSED, DONE; requires n == 0 and not A. Effects: n + 2, go ACTIVE.
  TICKET: allowed in INIT, ACTIVE, PAUSED, FAULT. Effects: n + 1, go INIT.
  CLOSE: allowed in INIT, READY, PAUSED, FAULT; requires not T. Effects: T=true, n + 1, go DONE.
